headline: Boeing (BA) Is Up 8.2% After Narrower Loss, Cash-Flow Reaffirmation And FAA Milestone - What's Changed
summary: Boeing reported past second-quarter 2026 results showing revenue of US$24,560 million versus US$22,749 million a year earlier, with net loss narrowing to US$444 million from US$611 million despite continued charges in its defense programs. Alongside higher commercial deliveries and restored FAA self-certification for 737 MAX and 787 jets, Boeing generated positive free cash flow and reaffirmed its full-year cash guidance, underscoring operational progress even as its defense segment remains...
